[quote=oceanice_republic;59788870][i][b]Oceanice Republic Officially Joins the Elseyran Defense Union.[/b]

From the Gate of Berlinwerk Parliamentary, Vanklyis Adelais Herman, leader of the Oceanice Republic, formally signed the agreement to join the Elseyran Defense Union or E.D.U. This marks a step toward building foreign relations, strengthening economic ties, and bolstering collective defense within Elseyr. Delegates from E.D.U. member states and Oceanice Republic officials formed an official joining of E.D.U immense with a huge crowd of cheers from the Parliament. 

[u]Vanklyis Adelais Herman's Address-
[/u]
This marks a new era for the Oceanice Republic. For too long, our national pride has been challenged by rivalries that sought to diminish us. Today, we take a stand not just for our sovereignty, but for our collective future. This partnership will revolutionize business, education, and economics, securing our place as a cornerstone of Elseyran unity. I am proud to lead this nation into a new age of prosperity. Long live our enduring relations with the E.D.U.![/i]

Welcoming the Oceanice Republics Entry into the Elseyran Defense Union (E.D.U.) 
 
Date: 26 June 2025  

From: His Majestys Royal Court, Celestial Palace Kestrahaim, Capital of Ekpatanus  

In the name of wisdom, splendor, and the solidarity of nations,

His Majesty Kaesarus III Sam Michaelidis, on behalf of the free and proud people of Ekpatanus, extends his heartfelt congratulations on the formal accession of the Federation of the Oceanice Republic into the Elseyran Defense Union.

In an era when the world more than ever calls for unity, wisdom, and cooperation, this historic step by the Oceanice Republic stands as a testament to diplomatic foresight and unwavering commitment to lasting peace, inclusive economic development, and collective security.

The words of the leader of the Oceanice Republic, Vanklyis Adelais Herman, reflect the courage of a nation and faith in the power of partnership. In Ekpatanus, we welcome this gesture of friendship with open arms and steadfast resolve, ready to build a future founded on the synergy of nations.

May the bond between Ekpatanus, the Oceanice Republic, and the distinguished members of the E.D.U. bear abundant fruit in the upliftment of our peoples.

By command of His Majesty:                                                            Καίσαρος Γ' Σαμ Μιχαηλίδης
